shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null || echo "NO DOCS DIR"
find pages components styles __agent_eval__ -type f | sort && echo "---TSCONFIG---" && cat tsconfig.json && echo "---NEXTCONFIG---" && cat next.config.ts && echo "---GITIGNORE---" && cat .gitignore
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs && find . -maxdepth 3 -type d | sort | head -60
cd /workspace && for f in pages/index.js pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js components/AppProvider.js; do echo "=========== $f ==========="; cat "$f"; done
for f in pages/blog/index.js pages/blog/\[id\].js pages/api/posts/index.js pages/api/posts/\[id\].js styles/globals.css __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=========== $f ==========="; cat "$f"; done

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs && ls 01-app/02-guides/migrating/ 01-app/02-guides/upgrading/ && echo "=== FILE CONVENTIONS ===" && ls 01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/ && echo "=== FUNCTIONS ===" && ls 01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/ && echo "=== DIRECTIVES ===" && ls 01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/ && echo "=== COMPONENTS ===" && ls 01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs && cat 01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md
wc -l 01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md 01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md && cat 01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference && ls 03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config/ 03-file-conventions/01-metadata/ && wc -l 03-file-conventions/page.md 03-file-conventions/layout.md 03-file-conventions/route.md 03-file-conventions/not-found.md 03-file-conventions/error.md 04-functions/generate-metadata.md 04-functions/generate-static-params.md 04-functions/use-router.md

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app && ls 02-guides/ && echo "=== GETTING STARTED ===" && ls 01-getting-started/ && echo "=== CONFIG ===" && ls 03-api-reference/05-config/ 03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/ 2>/dev/null | head -60

cd /workspace && timeout 15 node -e "fetch('https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts?_limit=1').then(r=>r.json()).then(d=>console.log('NET OK',JSON.stringify(d).slice(0,80))).catch(e=>console.log('NET FAIL',e.message))"
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions && sed -n '1,80p' userAgent.md

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference && sed -n '1,60p' 02-components/font.md && echo "===== DYNAMICPARAMS =====" && cat 03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config/dynamicParams.md
grep -n "typegen\|PageProps\|LayoutProps\|RouteContext\|next-env" 05-config/02-typescript.md | head -40

timeout 15 node -e "fetch('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap',{headers:{'user-agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}}).then(r=>console.log('FONTS OK',r.status)).catch(e=>console.log('FONTS FAIL',e.message))"
cat 04-functions/not-found.md | head -70 && echo "===== USE CLIENT (head) =====" && sed -n '1,50p' 01-directives/use-client.md
cat 05-config/01-next-config-js/appDir.md && echo "===== FILE CONVENTIONS INDEX =====" && cat 03-file-conventions/index.md

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app && grep -n "405\|Allow\|NextResponse\|Response.json\|method" 01-getting-started/15-route-handlers.md | head -30 && echo "=== LINK VERSION HISTORY ===" && tail -30 03-api-reference/02-components/link.md && echo "=== LOADING (head) ===" && sed -n '1,40p' 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -rn "not-found" 01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/generate-metadata.md | head -20; echo "--- error-handling guide: 404/metadata ---"; grep -n "metadata\|not-found\|notFound\|title" 01-app/01-getting-started/10-error-handling.md | head -40
cd /workspace && find pages components -type f | sort
rm -rf pages components/AppProvider.js && find app components lib -type f | sort
npx next typegen 2>&1 | tail -30
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -40
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -50

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; 
echo "=== GET / ==="; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>|Your user agent: [^<]*|Server-side rendered at: [^<]*|href="/blog/[0-9]+"' | head -8
echo "=== GET /blog ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/blog -o /dev/null -w 'status=%{http_code}\n'
echo "=== GET /blog/1 ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/blog/1 | grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>|Comments \([0-9]+\)' | head -4
echo "=== GET /blog/99999 (notFound) ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/blog/99999 -o /dev/null -w 'status=%{http_code}\n'
echo "=== GET /nope (not-found.tsx) ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/nope -w '\nstatus=%{http_code}\n' | grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>|404 - Page Not Found|status=[0-9]+' | head -4

echo "=== /nope head ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/nope | sed -n 's/.*<head>\(.*\)</head>.*/\1/p' | tr '>' '>
' | grep -iE 'title|description'
echo; echo "=== /blog/99999 body ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/blog/99999 -w '
status=%{http_code}
' | grep -oE '404 - Page Not Found|status=[0-9]+' | head
echo; echo "=== upstream check ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'jsonplaceholder /posts/99999 -> %{http_code}
' https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/99999
echo; echo "=== / dynamic values ==="; curl -s -A 'SmokeTest/1.0' localhost:3111 | grep -oE 'Server-side rendered at: <!-- -->[^<]*|Your user agent: <!-- -->[^<]*'

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && echo "=== headers /blog/99999 ==="; curl -sI localhost:3111/blog/99999 | head -12
echo; echo "=== docs: notFound status ==="; grep -rn "404" 01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/not-found.md 01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md | head -20
sed -n '/## Status codes/,/^## /p' 01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md
grep -n -i "status code" 01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md; echo "---"; sed -n '/[Ss]tatus [Cc]odes/,+22p' 01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "isFallback\|fallback: 'blocking'\|fallback: true" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -20
sed -n '182,206p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/02-pages/04-api-reference/03-functions/get-static-paths.md
pkill -f "next start" ; rm /workspace/app/blog/\[id\]/loading.tsx && echo "removed loading.tsx"
rm -f "/workspace/app/blog/[id]/loading.tsx"; ls "/workspace/app/blog/[id]/"
cd /workspace && rm -rf .next && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30

(npx next start -p 3112 > /tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6
echo "=== titles / descriptions (dedup check) ==="
for p in / /blog /blog/1 /nope; do printf '%-10s ' "$p"; curl -s localhost:3112$p | grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>' | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done
echo; echo "=== 404 statuses ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '/blog/99999  -> %{http_code}\n' localhost:3112/blog/99999
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '/nope        -> %{http_code}\n' localhost:3112/nope
echo; echo "=== API GET /api/posts ==="; curl -s localhost:3112/api/posts -w ' [%{http_code}]\n'
echo "=== API POST valid ==="; curl -s -X POST localhost:3112/api/posts -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"T","content":"C"}' -w ' [%{http_code}]\n'
echo "=== API POST missing fields ==="; curl -s -X POST localhost:3112/api/posts -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"T"}' -w ' [%{http_code}]\n'
echo "=== API POST empty body ==="; curl -s -X POST localhost:3112/api/posts -w ' [%{http_code}]\n'
echo "=== API auto-405 (DELETE /api/posts) ==="; curl -s -X DELETE localhost:3112/api/posts -o /dev/null -D - -w 'status=%{http_code}\n' | grep -iE '^allow|status='
echo "=== API GET /api/posts/7 ==="; curl -s localhost:3112/api/posts/7 -w ' [%{http_code}]\n'
echo "=== API PUT /api/posts/7 ==="; curl -s -X PUT localhost:3112/api/posts/7 -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"New"}' -w ' [%{http_code}]\n'
echo "=== API DELETE /api/posts/7 ==="; curl -s -X DELETE localhost:3112/api/posts/7 -w ' [%{http_code}]\n'
echo "=== API auto-405 (POST /api/posts/7) ==="; curl -s -X POST localhost:3112/api/posts/7 -o /dev/null -D - -w 'status=%{http_code}\n' | grep -iE '^allow|status='

cd /workspace
echo "=== fonts: googleapis references in HTML? ==="; curl -s localhost:3112/ | grep -c 'fonts.googleapis.com' 
echo "=== self-hosted font preload ==="; curl -s localhost:3112/ | grep -oE '<link rel="preload" href="/_next/static/media/[^"]*"[^>]*>' | head -2
echo "=== --font-inter applied ==="; curl -s localhost:3112/ | grep -oE '<html[^>]*>' 
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null
echo; echo "=== leftover Pages Router APIs in source ==="
grep -rn "next/router\|next/head\|getServerSideProps\|getStaticProps\|getStaticPaths\|getInitialProps\|NextApiRequest\|NextApiResponse\|req\.body\|req\.query" app components lib styles *.ts *.json 2>/dev/null || echo "none"
echo; echo "=== remaining .js/.jsx source files ==="
find app components lib -name '*.js' -o -name '*.jsx' | grep -v node_modules || echo "none"
echo; echo "=== pages dir ==="; ls -d pages 2>&1
echo; echo "=== final tree ==="; find app components lib -type f | sort
echo; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short

cd /workspace
echo "=== self-hosted font files in build ==="; find .next -name '*.woff2' | head -3
echo; echo "=== leftover Pages Router APIs in source ==="
grep -rn "next/router\|next/head\|getServerSideProps\|getStaticProps\|getStaticPaths\|getInitialProps\|NextApiRequest\|NextApiResponse\|req\.body\|req\.query" app components lib styles *.ts 2>/dev/null || echo "none"
echo; echo "=== remaining .js/.jsx source files ==="
find app components lib -name '*.js' -o -name '*.jsx' 2>/dev/null | head || echo "none"
echo; echo "=== pages dir ==="; ls -d pages 2>&1
echo; echo "=== final tree ==="; find app components lib -type f | sort
echo; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short

rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && printf '
# typescript
*.tsbuildinfo
' >> .gitignore && git diff tsconfig.json
npx tsc --noEmit && echo "TYPECHECK OK" && rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && npx next build 2>&1 | grep -E '✓|✗|Error|error|Route|├|└|┌|●|○|ƒ'
rm -f /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git status --short
